en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a tranquil lake surrounded by lush trees and palms. Small rowboats with passengers glide across the water. On the left stands a pavilion or boathouse with a white roof and several small boats moored nearby. The scene is framed as a picturesque urban park. At the bottom of the image there is printed red text indicating the location and a catalogue number.
